objective: Test whether a larger update budget improves the released initial-expert tracking pilot; not full PhyGile reproduction
selection_rule: Evaluate the fixed final checkpoint after 2000 total updates; no checkpoint selection using held-out test scores
known_limits: One training seed and one held-out source group
Previously inspected test set: exploratory comparison, not a fresh confirmatory benchmark
Only initial expert; no two-stage GMT or generator/physics-prefix reproduction
World-frame errors are censored at failure
Checkpoint continuation resets simulator, sampler, rollout and RNG state
